text:
liz_cs: quick heads-up — HelionWare is planning to add two new squads (Search QA + Field Support) and wants nightly embedding for product docs + live assist for support. renewal in ~45 days, seems like a solid expansion signal.

omar_se: do we have rough volumes? new vs migrating?

liz_cs: mostly new. initial bulk: ~600k docs -> ~1.1M vectors. steady state: ~4k embed ops/day. live assist expected ~60 rps peak internal during business hours. they specifically asked about predictable pricing and an SLA for latency.

devin_sales: sales angle 10% uplift if we bundle embed batch credits + short Dedicated pilot. will draft a pricing sketch.

nora_onb: onboarding notes 1 workshop done. customer asked for an "embedding hygiene" checklist and retriever eval rubric. I'll prepare samples and an agenda.

omar_se: SE action items:
- validate ingest pattern (chunking, backpressure)
- recommend Dedicated pilot sizing (1x A100 equiv, autoscale for nightly)
- set caching TTLs to keep p95 <200ms
- propose quantization/storage savings for vectors

ops_bot: HelionWare account snapshot:
 Plan: Team Hosted
 Dedicated: none
 7d peak tokens: 900k/day
 Soft limits: standard burst only
Recommendation: consider short Dedicated trial to guarantee throughput for nightly batch.

liz_cs: risks: hitting soft limits during ingest (churn risk if throttled) and legal asking about PII handling for Field Support.

devin_sales: i'll sync with finance for a 3-mo reserved commit option + discount on batch.

nora_onb: i'll collect 3 doc samples and expected query templates before the workshop. also propose a short eval set for retriever precision checks.

omar_se: creating internal ticket CS-9407 for HelionWare sizing and runbook. will add load-test plan.

liz_cs: recap: devin -> commercial by Thu; omar -> sizing + load-test in CS-9407; nora -> sample data and rubric. keep this tight given renewal timeline. :rocket:
